capability: Today, pinned cards, First Loaf/Baker mode, join an existing bake
acceptance_contract: Contextual next action, date/window, jar/dough label; switch help level mid-bake without changing data

capability: New, established, gifted and multiple starters; lineage
acceptance_contract: Track parent/offshoot, flour/hydration/storage and unknown age accurately; no compulsory restart

capability: Feed repeat, calculator, retained/build/discard weights; correction/backdating
acceptance_contract: Inputs conserve mass; distinguish planned versus actual; correction preserves audit history

capability: Counter, fridge, travel, pause, snooze, revival and low-waste maintenance
acceptance_contract: Per-jar schedules, no guilt streaks; recipe starter needs and retained amount reconciled

capability: Rise/temperature observations, guided photo sequence, charts, time-lapse
acceptance_contract: Mark missed peaks unknown; manual confirmation before photo-derived measurements affect engines

capability: Personalised starter check/peak windows and troubleshooting
acceptance_contract: Show comparable sample count, conditions, broad fallback and reviewed spoilage guidance

capability: Forward, backward and in-progress planning; cooling included
acceptance_contract: Start/mix/oven/serve anchors distinct; all windows and hands-on obligations visible before acceptance

capability: Availability, sleep, saved templates; optional calendar busy import/export
acceptance_contract: No hidden overnight obligations; request minimum permissions; no event-title collection for busy import

capability: Kitchen temperatures, oven, vessels, loaf/pan dimensions, fridge capacity
acceptance_contract: All assumptions displayed; missing kitchen data is explicit; one Dutch oven can never do two simultaneous loads

capability: Multiple bakes, resource conflicts, compatible task batching
acceptance_contract: Separate dough events; oven transitions/reheat, cooling and capacity represented; conflict explanations usable

capability: Scale by count/weight/percentages; units; shopping/prep/print sheets
acceptance_contract: Starter flour/water counted once; uncertain volume conversions marked; rounding never changes stored formula

capability: Delay/missed fold/slow rise/oven failure recovery
acceptance_contract: Freeze actual history; show recipe-supported alternatives, new serve window and reminder changes before apply

capability: Kitchen-friendly live steps, current ingredient weights, screen awake, voice
acceptance_contract: Large controls; optional per-session awake state; speech transcript confirmed before mutations

capability: Independent durable timers, snooze/backdate/early completion, missed alerts
acceptance_contract: App kill/restart/reboot and permission denial tested; current state reconstructed from timestamps/events

capability: Lock-screen activity, widget and supported watch status/action
acceptance_contract: Swift/Kotlin platform targets, explicit OS/device support, stale-state labels and constrained quick actions

capability: Dough readings, percentage rise, side-by-side photos, no-thermometer route
acceptance_contract: Separate estimated check from observed readiness; no fake precision when data is missing

capability: Supported probes and foreground camera monitoring
acceptance_contract: Published device/protocol tests; disconnect/staleness/battery/foreground status; manual entry always available

capability: Short technique demonstrations, captions/text/left-handed views and private step notes
acceptance_contract: Reviewed, rights-cleared assets; pinned offline lesson packs; notes carry into a copied bake

capability: Bread-family recipe collection and precise filters
acceptance_contract: Distinct execution graphs for rye/focaccia/pizza/enriched/discard; no one-loaf method stretched to every bread

capability: URL/photo/text recipe import, source attribution, private copies and versions
acceptance_contract: SSRF/content limits; human review; imported constraints never labelled tested automatically

capability: Courses, practical exercises and contextual learning
acceptance_contract: Resume points and exercise evidence; help always returns to current bake without losing its state

capability: Flour/equipment substitution, custom ingredients, uncertainty
acceptance_contract: Explain changed hydration/handling/equipment constraints; outside validated envelope marked experimental

capability: Pantry, flour notes, discard inventory, aggregated shopping, batch cost
acceptance_contract: Units/stock events consistent; user prices dated; no invented live grocery prices

capability: Accessibility, units, printable/shareable formula and schedule
acceptance_contract: Dynamic text, screen readers, captions, contrast, reduced motion, large targets and simple view verified

capability: Automatic journal, outcomes, notes/photos/tags; Bake Again
acceptance_contract: Exact immutable formula version, timeline and corrections retained; copies get new IDs

capability: Side-by-side comparisons, charts, baselines and one-variable experiments
acceptance_contract: Show missing variables/sample counts; do not turn personal associations into causal advice

capability: Contextual text coach, optional image/crumb analysis, reviewed sources
acceptance_contract: Per-request consent/context preview; suggestions cannot directly mutate a plan; uncertainty and report action

capability: Personal recipe book, structured data export, selected bake-card share
acceptance_contract: Export works without a subscription; private photos/metadata excluded unless selected

capability: Runnable attributed recipe links, starter care links, revisions, revocation
acceptance_contract: Copy vs live link behaviour explicit; revoked link fails online; already-saved recipient copies cannot be recalled

capability: Households/shared bakes, view/edit roles, tasks and acknowledged handoffs
acceptance_contract: Explicit membership, revocation and stale offline edits; actor attribution; no last-write-wins loss of feeding/completion

capability: Community bakes/groups/challenges, publish loaf, creator saves/updates
acceptance_contract: Private by default; report/block, moderation/appeal and notification preferences; no public exposure of kitchen availability

capability: Production view, quantities/pickup windows/oven loads/labels/pack lists/cost/yield
acceptance_contract: Separate home/production context; batch traceability and resource checks; no commercial food-safety certification claims

capability: Reminder preferences, quiet hours, pins, social/coach controls
acceptance_contract: Separate safety-critical/user timers and routine reminders; no silent override of permission/quiet-hour choices

capability: Local-only use, opted-in cloud sync, multi-device backups
acceptance_contract: No network account required for core local use; explicit migration/restore/conflict UX; no promise of end-to-end encryption

capability: Granular photo/calendar/device/sharing consent; record/account deletion
acceptance_contract: Permissions requested at point of use; export/revoke/delete tested across objects, shares, providers and sync devices

capability: Complete operational product
acceptance_contract: Editorial publication, migrations, review queues, support ownership, backups/restore, quotas and incident runbooks ready
